messages:
sarah_ops: heads up — we're seeing new GPU nodes in us-west-3 fail to come healthy. error in keystore logs: `Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException (GrantNotFound)`

james_infra: trying to repro in staging now. looks like the KMS grant that allows the gpu-node role to decrypt ephemeral keys expired earlier today. no deploy planned that would touch grants.

liam_sec: confirmed from audit — an automated rotation job removed grants older than 90d, and the job didn't re-apply a grant for the node role because the principal string changed after the role rename last month.

anna_sre: impact: ~8% of cluster capacity in usw3 unready. autoscaler is still trying to launch replacements but they fail at bootstrap decrypt step so warm pools are starving.

caroline_fin: putting this in the "cost" bucket — if we shift traffic to eu we pay cross-region egress and higher tail latency for some customers. estimate extra infra cost ~ $1.2k/day if we keep rerouting.

james_infra: short-term mitigation: manually re-create a grant for the node role so in-flight nodes can decrypt and join. command I ran in staging (will do PROD with approval):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/keystore-prod --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gpu-node-role-usw3 --operations Decrypt
```
logs show the same error: `KMS:AccessDenied — GrantNotFound for grantId null`

liam_sec: we can't just blindly create grants in prod without review. I'll approve a scoped emergency grant if you file a quick access request in #security-approvals with the principals and expiry. Recommend expiry = 24h and then we plan a proper fix.

anna_sre: for immediate capacity relief can we also spin up a small cross-region warmpool in eu-west-1 and route non-sensitive traffic there? we can throttle to minimize cost.

james_infra: yes we can, but it takes ~12m for a warmpool slice to be useful. I'll start a limited warmpool now.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] 6375550180 — keystore-bootstrap-failure spree detected in cluster: ml-usw3; failing nodes: 12; symptom: KMS Decrypt AccessDenied.

caroline_fin: please track the expected daily cost if this lasts >24h. Also we should factor in support SLO credits if customers see degraded perf.

liam_sec: approved emergency grant for the gpu-node role (ticket SEC-2026). Created grant with 24h TTL. james, please apply and confirm. Security note: we rotated the grantee principal back to the canonical role name to avoid repeated drift.

james_infra: applied in prod. I'm seeing nodes finish bootstrap and join — capacity recovering. will keep the warmpool in eu small and standby.

anna_sre: verified autoscaler now sees healthy nodes and pending queue draining. ETA to full capacity ~ 18 minutes.

liam_sec: next steps (postmortem):
- rollout a fix to the rotation job so it maps role aliases -> canonical principals and re-applies grants correctly.
- add an integration test that simulates role renames and validates grant re-creation.
- alert on grant count delta for each key (if grants drop > 3 within 1h)
- consider switching to a kms proxy that keeps a short-lived cache for decrypt operations to smooth transient grant windows.

james_infra: I'll open infra-ticket INFRA-4387 with the rotation job patch and the integration test. tagging anna as owner for the warmpool fallback runbook update.

caroline_fin: let's capture cost tradeoffs in the ticket: manual grant vs proxy vs permanent broader grant. include a conservative 30-day forecast.

anna_sre: agreed. I'll update the runbook and add a checklist: check grant TTL, role canonicalization, and fallback warmpool plan.

liam_sec: one more precaution — schedule a canary change to rotation job in staging that runs with a dry-run mode and emits a metric `keystore.rotation.missing_grant` so we can catch regressions.

james_infra: done, pushing dry-run to staging now. will post results.

deploy-bot: [INFO] 6375553500 — capacity recovered: cluster ml-usw3 healthy_percent=98.7

sarah_ops: huge thanks team. please keep SEC ticket and INFRA ticket linked so we can close with a follow-up summary. :thumbsup:
